text: John Matoian, born in 1948, is a former teacher and television industry executive who served as vice-president of the CBS Entertainment division. He became president of Entertainment at Fox Broadcasting in September 1995 and later held the position of president at HBO from 1996 to 1999. Matoian earned his B.A. from Stanford University and is a native of Fresno, of Armenian descent. During the 2012 United States Presidential election, he contributed $83,800 to Barack Obama's presidential campaign. In his book Springfield Confidential, Mike Reiss identifies Matoian as the Fox executive who harbored an intense hatred of the animated series The Critic, produced by Reiss and Al Jean, which resulted in the show being canceled after only one season on the network.
